name: Alcides
bible: A towering giant hunter, hunched under his curse, with enormous shoulders and a heavy, scarred, muscular BARE TORSO. Gaunt weathered face, heavy black brow, deep-set glowing AMBER eyes, short black beard. Long MATTED BLACK hair past the shoulder blades. Tan skin with raised dark scars. RUSTED IRON-BROWN chains with bronze links cross his chest and wrap both forearms. He wears the NEMEAN LION PELT: a huge tawny-gold lion skin mantling his shoulders down to the knees, the lion head with its dark golden mane resting on his LEFT shoulder like a pauldron, never covering his face, its forepaws knotted across his chest over the chains. Black-brown leather loincloth and trousers, hip straps, boots. WEAPON: a huge black GREATBOW nearly as tall as his body, black lacquered horn on a blackened iron riser, rust-bound tips, thick dark sinew cord. He holds it upright in his LEFT hand and draws the cord with his RIGHT hand to the cheek. Black arrows with bronze-brown fletching ride in a hip quiver, heads dipped in HYDRA VENOM. Energy and trails: ACID-GREEN venom streaks with black smoke and dark crimson droplets.
design:
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right, towering and hunched, the greatbow held upright in the left hand and the lion pelt over his shoulders; a three-quarter close-up of the head with amber eyes, matted hair, beard and the lion head on the left shoulder; a close view of the bow's grip, rust-bound tips and one venom-tipped arrow
- second row: a combat stance with the bow held low; the full draw with the cord at the cheek; a running pose with the lion pelt streaming behind him; a jump with the bow raised
- third row: an arrow release with an acid-green venom trail; a plunge with the bow pointed straight down; a fully drawn power shot with a huge venom comet; a crouched guard with the bow held across the body
- bottom row: a hit reaction with chains snapping, a knocked-down pose, a victory pose planting the bow butt-first with a hand on the lion's head, the Serpent Rain volley of venom arrows arcing skyward

atk-a.title: Basic combo strikes 1 and 2: venom arrow shots (4 frames each)
frames: combo strike 1, anticipation: he draws an arrow from the quiver at his hip and nocks it, the greatbow held upright in the left hand, the right hand pulling the cord back toward the cheek, the lion pelt swinging on his back

combo strike 1, strike: the venom arrow loosed forward with a sharp snap, a streak of acid-green venom and black smoke trailing from its head,, with a motion smear of the swing, kept inside this cell, the bow still bent

combo strike 1, follow-through: the same blow carried on past full extension, the weapon at the very end of its path and the body still committed to it, the trail thinning out behind it (kept inside this cell)
combo strike 1, recovery: the bow lowered after the shot, the cord still humming, the right hand back at the hip
combo strike 2, anticipation: a faster second draw, the bow tilted slightly up, the arrow drawn back to the ear and held

combo strike 2, strike: a second venom arrow shot forward and slightly downward, a bright acid-green arc trail with black smoke, with a motion smear of the swing, kept inside this cell, a few dark droplets flying off the bow limb

combo strike 2, follow-through: the same blow carried on past full extension, the weapon at the very end of its path and the body still committed to it, the trail thinning out behind it (kept inside this cell)
combo strike 2, recovery: the bow swept down and back toward stance, the chains and the lion pelt swinging forward

atk-b.title: Combo finisher: a triple venom volley, and an aerial shot (4 frames each)
frames: combo finisher, anticipation: a huge full draw, the greatbow bent far back by the right hand at the shoulder, the left arm braced forward, body coiled and the weight sinking onto the back leg

combo finisher, strike: three venom-tipped arrows loosed together in a fan forward, acid-green streaks with black smoke, with a motion smear of the swing, kept inside this cell, the body lunging into the shot, the strongest pose

combo finisher, follow-through: the same blow carried on past full extension, the weapon at the very end of its path and the body still committed to it, the trail thinning out behind it (kept inside this cell)
combo finisher, recovery: deep follow-through, the bow arm extended, the chains and the lion pelt flaring, settling back toward stance
aerial attack, anticipation: in mid-air with the body tucked, the greatbow raised and a venom-tipped arrow nocked and drawn
aerial attack, strike: a shot fired downward and forward from the air, a sweeping acid-green venom arc trail with black smoke, with a motion smear of the swing, kept inside this cell

aerial attack, follow-through: the same blow carried on past full extension, the weapon at the very end of its path and the body still committed to it, the trail thinning out behind it (kept inside this cell)
aerial attack, recovery: airborne, body tucked, the bow returning to a ready pose

atk-c.title: Plunge: a downward venom shot, and a fully drawn power shot (4 frames each)
frames: plunge, dive: in mid-air, the greatbow pointed straight down beneath the body with a venom-tipped arrow nocked on the cord, speed lines and black smoke streaming upward
plunge, impact: landing in a low crouch, the arrow driven into the ground in front with a burst of venom-green spatter and dust, the bow braced in the left hand

plunge, follow-through: the same blow carried on past full extension, the weapon at the very end of its path and the body still committed to it, the trail thinning out behind it (kept inside this cell)
plunge, recovery: rising from the impact back toward stance, the bow lifted again
heavy attack, charge: the greatbow drawn to full draw, the cord pulled to the jaw, the arrowhead glowing with building acid-green venom light, body coiled
heavy attack, strike: a fully drawn power shot released with a huge venom comet trail, with a motion smear of the swing, kept inside this cell, the bow limbs flexing wide

heavy attack, follow-through: the same blow carried on past full extension, the weapon at the very end of its path and the body still committed to it, the trail thinning out behind it (kept inside this cell)
heavy attack, follow-through: deep follow-through, the bow arm extended, black venom smoke dissipating

sheetNotes.idle: The greatbow is always held upright in front of him in the LEFT hand, its lower limb near the ground; the right hand stays empty and relaxed. The chains and the lion pelt drift with the breath, and the lion's head stays on the left shoulder. Keep the bow the same height and angle in all four loop frames.
sheetNotes.run: He runs with a heavy, loping stride, the bow held upright in the left hand and tilting with each step. The chains swing on the chest and the lion pelt streams behind him.
sheetNotes.air: Airborne, the bow stays in the left hand. In the rising and falling frames the chains and the lion pelt fly upward behind him.
sheetNotes.dash: The greatbow stays in the LEFT hand through the roll and the dash, held clear of the ground. The lion pelt wraps and flares around him. In the heal frames the bow stays in the left hand while the right hand takes the flask.
sheetNotes.hurt: The greatbow stays in the LEFT hand through every hit; when knocked down it lies beside him, still gripped in the left hand. The chains snap outward and the lion pelt swings and jolts with the blow. The lion's head stays on his left shoulder wherever the body allows.
sheetNotes.atk-a: The greatbow is held in the LEFT hand throughout, and every shot is made with the RIGHT hand on the cord. The venom arrows carry acid-green heads with black smoke trails; the lion pelt swings with the body and never covers his face.
sheetNotes.atk-b: The greatbow is drawn with the RIGHT hand and braced by the LEFT hand throughout. The three-arrow volley and the aerial shot leave acid-green venom trails with black smoke, all kept inside the cell; the lion pelt flares with the lunge.
sheetNotes.atk-c: The greatbow is pointed down or drawn in the hands as described, always with the LEFT hand on the grip. The plunge impact throws venom-green spatter and dust, and the heavy strike releases a huge venom comet trail; the lion pelt and chains move with the body.
sheetNotes.art: Serpent Rain, Alcides' Rift Art. Frames 1-2 (anticipation): 1 he draws the greatbow up toward the sky with the cord at his cheek; 2 the arrowhead blazing acid-green, power at its peak. Frames 3-4 (execution): 3 he looses a volley of venom arrows skyward, the shafts curving up and back toward the centre of the cell, kept inside the cell; 4 the arrows drop around the target spot near the right of the cell in one serpentine coil, a many-headed serpent shape of black smoke and acid-green venom, kept inside the cell. Frames 5-6 (recovery): 5 the bow lowered, the venom smoke fading; 6 back to stance, the greatbow upright in the left hand, the lion pelt settling.
sheetNotes.misc: Frames 1-3 skill throw: 1 he reaches back with the free right hand for a barbed iron chain link; 2 he flings the link forward, arm extended; 3 follow-through. Frames 4-5 taunt: he snaps an arrow shaft across his knee and lets the broken pieces fall (a debt repaid), then bares his teeth and raises his chin, the chains rattling. Frames 6-8 victory: he plants the greatbow butt-first in the ground beside him, rests one hand on the lion's head on his shoulder, and lifts his face to the sky with a grim, triumphant look, the chains and lion pelt settling.
sheetNotes.ko: Defeat (frames 1-4): he staggers from the blow, drops to one knee with the greatbow still in the left hand, collapses forward and lies motionless, the lion pelt spread on the ground. Intro (frames 5-8): he walks in hunched and slow with the greatbow held upright by its grip in the left hand, chains clinking and the lion pelt swaying on his back; he raises the bow overhead with a fierce stare, draws one arrow from the quiver and nocks it, flourishes the bow once in a wide arc, and settles into the stance with the bow upright.
sheetNotes.skill: Nine Lives, his own special (three venom-tipped black arrows loosed at once in a fan). He uses the black greatbow, held upright in the LEFT hand. 1: he draws the cord back toward the cheek with the RIGHT hand, a black arrow coming from the hip quiver. 2: full draw, three black arrows with acid-green venom-tipped heads nocked on the cord at once. 3: he looses, the three arrows leaving the bow in a fan. 4: the fan of three arrows at full spread at full force, acid-green venom trails with black smoke streaming behind them, the bow still drawn back. 5: the bow lowering, the venom smoke dying out. 6: back in stance, the greatbow upright in the left hand, the lion pelt settling.
